title: jasminum suaveolens
intro: Jasminum suaveolens, commonly known as the night-scented jasmine or sweet jasmine, is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayas and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its fragrance and medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Jasminum suaveolens include its sedative and antispasmodic properties, which can help to calm the nervous system and alleviate muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of Jasminum suaveolens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential health benefits.
